summary: - **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/171)** — k4ActsTracking adopts the ACTS single-actor propagator API and now requires an ACTS version including acts-project/acts#6410, so builds against older ACTS releases will fail.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#538](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/538)** — Adds a DIRAC grid backend, "fccanalysis submit grid", which resolves EOS/XRootD or LFN inputs into deterministic chunked jobs submitted via ILCDIRAC; deprecated "submit --where" syntax raises a migration error.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#683](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/683)** — Magnetic field set to zero outside the muon systems of ALLEGRO, IDEA, CLD_o2_v09 and CLD_o5_v01, so escaping particles no longer curl back into the detector during simulation.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#690](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/690)** — IDEA parallel-world tracking volume changed from connected Air to disconnected Vacuum, removing material overlaps that affected reconstruction; the tracking volume is added to IDEA_o2_v01.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#128](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/128)** — GGTFTrackFinder identifies input collections by their position in the input list instead of unassigned collection IDs, fixing crashes and wrong hit assignments in ALLEGRO and IDEA reconstruction.

- **[key4hep/k4DetectorPerformance#15](https://github.com/key4hep/k4DetectorPerformance/pull/15)** — TrackingValidation keys hits and MC particles by EDM4hep handles, fixing wrong track–particle associations and underestimated true-hit counts when validation runs in the same job as digitisation (see also **key4hep/k4ActsTracking#169**).

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#152](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/152)** — CKF extrapolation to the IP includes beam-pipe material, correcting underestimated d0/z0 uncertainties for low-momentum tracks, as shown in CLD_o2_v08 pull studies.

- **[key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter#293](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/293)** — Sliding-window clustering can optionally re-centre its position window, and AugmentClustersFCCee can apply S-curve corrections to per-layer theta barycentres, improving low-energy cluster positions in ALLEGRO.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#565](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/565)** — get_V0s_jet and get_SV_jets build each jet's V0s and secondary vertices from its own tracks rather than other jets', changing per-jet vertex outputs for all affected analyses.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#569](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/569)** — get_PrimaryTracks no longer drops a compatible track on its first pass, and beam-spot-constrained vertex fits use 2N degrees of freedom, changing primary-vertex selections and chi2 values.
